articles.title: What Syria’s revolution can teach the world about democracy
articles.excerpt: In an interview with Syria Direct, journalist and author Anand Gopal reflects on Syria’s unfinished revolution, its democratic experiments and the challenges facing the country’s new leadership. The post What Syria’s revolution can teach the world about democracy appeared first on Syria Direct.
